column1: # Published release ledger — version <TAB> publish date (UTC) <TAB> build commit.
# The build commit is the private repo's commit the artifacts were built from. It
# was originally recovered from the publish-dist workflow runs' head_sha (no tags
# existed for 0.1.0-0.2.3); every published version is now also tagged v<version>,
# so `git show v0.2.3` is the quicker lookup and this file is the human-readable
# index. gen-changelog.sh reads it to build the dist repo's CHANGELOG.
# Append a row as part of publishing (docs/35 §35.8.2), newest last.
